name: Jivial Industries Limited
about: Jivial Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of aluminum and stainless-steel components used in railing systems in India. The company manufactures finished aluminum railings and fixtures from unfinished extruded aluminum railings and unfinished aluminum castings. It specializes in aluminum extrusion and casting processes to produce a wide range of railing-related products. The company offers aluminum railings and fixtures to hold glass for partitions, staircases, ramps, balconies, viewing windows, and facade of buildings. It manufactures two types of railings including continous profiles, used for holding the glass at the bottom and; handrails for holding the glass at the top along with design for hand support. Further, it manufactures several aluminum fixtures used in supporting the railings to hold glass, such as, spigot, conceal, bend, bracket, jointer, lock and endcap. The company's customers include small and medium-level construction companies, wholesalers, architects, interior designers, real estate developers, glass providers and fabricators, and contractors for use in residential and commercial infrastructure projects. In addition, its products are used in hotels and resorts, hospitals and clinics, schools and institutions, apartments and high rises, luxury villas, and shopping malls. Jivial Industries Limited was founded in 2006 and is based in Rajkot, India.
